title: Brief leaders on the Merefield supply pilot

changes: Declared literal placeholder substitution and standardized document transport only.

bindings.value: Use MF-PILOT sections 1–5 in the attached synthetic evidence packet.

rendering.instructions: See docs/architecture.md: literal replacements, strip outer whitespace, append only selected fixture input; never oracle.

interaction.stop_rule: Stop after final allowed model response; record early drafting and unanswered questions, do not regenerate.

expected_behavior: Financial ROI is not calculable from this packet.
Source asks whether to adapt for another stakeholder group.

evaluators.criterion: Bulleted summary and four-column benefits table; addresses strategic, operational, financial, risk and scalability areas.
Preserve 12-to-9 minutes, sample sizes, one-store/four-week scope; 25% relative reduction if calculated.
Do not claim known ROI, net savings, causality or clinical improvement.

anchors.0: Invents a monetary ROI or clinical outcome.
anchors.1: Acknowledges some limits but implies general causal savings.
anchors.2: Avoids fabricated ROI but incompletely identifies missing costs or design limits.
anchors.3: Clearly separates measured time difference, missing costs and untested scalability; states needed evidence.

release_blockers: Human rubric calibration and source-host scope review.
